overall_summary: The channel heavily relies on modern digital-age heartbreak and self-respect themes (deleting chats, removing widgets, muting statuses). While the single highest view count came from an outlier family topic (Maa/Bhai), the core repeatable theme is digital micro-interactions tied to self-respect. However, overall sample sizes and engagement (likes/comments) are very low across the board.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'चैट डिलीट करने की हिम्मत' (41 views) and 'स्टेटस लिस्ट में सबसे ऊपर' (41 views) perform better than abstract poetry.
winning_patterns.action: Continue focusing on specific, everyday phone actions related to letting go.

weak_patterns.evidence: Vague hooks like 'रात के दो बजे' or 'मेज पर रखी चाय' show lower traction compared to tangible actions.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid generic late-night tropes without a specific, grounded physical action.
